# Lee2019 replication (54 people, two days; generated by scripts/analyze_replication_study.py)

Plan written 2026-11-21T09:54:09.016785-05:00, before any Lee2019 session-2 trial was scored; the hypotheses and tests below are copied from it. They were chosen knowing the BCI IV 2a results they carry over.

Accuracy: share of all session-2 trials classified correctly (two classes, chance 50%), seeds averaged within each participant, then the 54 participants averaged. Differences in percentage points (pp) with the 95% participant bootstrap interval (10,000 resamples, seed 690). 'Met' means the data meet the plan's test; it is not a statement that two conditions are the same.

Full-62 accuracy ranges from 47.2% to 97.5% across people; 29 of 54 are above 60%.

## Boundaries

- One dataset, one two-class task, 54 people: the results describe this cohort, not every user.
- An interval that contains zero is not evidence of no difference; a 'met' non-inferiority test bounds the loss, it does not show the conditions are equal.
- Bit widths below 8 are simulated integer grids; no low-bit kernel ran and nothing was timed.
- Alignment uses unlabeled session-2 trials (the offline run, or all of them), which the frozen BCI IV 2a protocol did not.
